_about: MERGED endpoint map for the TP-Link TL-SG1016PE Easy Smart switch (V1/V3 family). It supersedes router/tl-sg1016pe-endpoints.json: all 27 of that file's capabilities are here, with corrections noted in `_reconciliation`. Plain HTTP :80, no JSON API. Pages embed state as inline `var NAME = VALUE;` JS, and writes go to *.cgi or POSTed *Rpm.htm forms. Confidence: VERIFIED = in the reference client's code (vmakeev/hass_tplink_easy_smart, MIT, @857d27a), in the owner's own fingerprinted login page, or two independent clients agree; INFERRED = seen only on sibling models, or deduced; UNKNOWN = needs an S0 capture. Prose: switch-protocol.md.

_conventions.kind: page = GET returning HTML with inline vars; cgi = action handler (writes or session ops)
_conventions.fields: request form/query fields for cgi; variables = inline JS vars a page carries
_conventions.mutates: true = changes device state; gated by EASYSMART_ALLOW_WRITES + confirm_write and honours EASYSMART_DRY_RUN
_conventions.x10: values marked x10 are tenths of the unit
_conventions.unauth: every page/cgi except / and /logon.cgi returns the ~15 KB login page (contains `var logonInfo`) when the session is missing, timed out or evicted; HTTP status stays 200
_conventions.headers: send `Referer: http://<host>/` on every request (browser behaviour; one report says logon needs it). Form posts are application/x-www-form-urlencoded

variables.logonInfo: new Array(errType, ?, ?) - errType per logon.cgi; the other two are unexplained (always 0 so far)
variables.g_year: int, copyright year (2022 on the owner's switch)

endpoints.notes: Unauthenticated: the login page (errType 0). Authenticated: the main frameset (no logonInfo). On cookie-variant firmware this response sets `H_P_SSID=tplink_<...>; Max-Age=600`, which logon.cgi requires. Also the auth_variant probe target (look for encryptType / cryp_new.js / g_tid / plain_password). errType 6 here = restored-account (factory reset) mode: refuse to log in.

fields.cpassword: empty string (only used when errType 6 forces a password change)

endpoints.response: Always HTTP 200 + the login page. logonInfo[0]: 0 = ok OR silently ignored (indistinguishable; verify with a data GET), 1 = bad user/password, 2 = user not allowed to login, 3 = user slots full, 4 = sessions full (16 allowed), 5 = session timeout, 6 = password must be changed (account_restored). On success the page's JS redirects to /. Some SG108E builds RST the connection instead of answering.
endpoints.confidence: VERIFIED (fields/errTypes from owner's login page JS; errType-0 ambiguity from reference issue #49 and the page's own onload logic)
endpoints.source: owner fingerprint; reference coreapi.authenticate; tlsg10x login.go; SwitchDeck sd_tplink.go
endpoints.guards: RESTORED_ACCOUNT_MODE: if the GET / probe (or any logon response) has logonInfo[0]==6, the page is in factory-reset 'New Password/Confirm' mode (submit 'Confirm', account_restored=1). A POST would set the admin password. Never POST; trip the breaker.

endpoints.response: login page; clears the server-side session for this client
endpoints.confidence: INFERRED for TL-SG1016PE (VERIFIED on TL-SG108E via tlsg10x/SwitchDeck and on TL-SE2106 Menu.htm `location.href="/Logout.htm"`)

_reconciliation: portConfig READ encodings: the old file listed priority as 1|2|3 and powerlimit as 1..6. Those are the WRITE codes. REF classes.py reads priority 0=High 1=Middle 2=Low, and powerlimit as tenths of a watt (330 auto; 40/70/154/300 class presets; else manual). The write side maps them with +1 and the 1..6 code table (REF tplink_api _POE_PRIORITIES_SET_MAP / _POE_POWER_LIMITS_SET_MAP). VERIFIED. There is no 'powerlimit2' read key.

Confidence was raised to VERIFIED where REF code implements the call and REF issue #2 confirms a TL-SG1016PE 3.0 works (system_info, PoeConfigRpm, poe_port_config.cgi, poe_global_config.cgi, PortSettingRpm, port_setting.cgi).

Login: the password is 6-16 chars, and in restored-account mode (errType 6) the submit value becomes 'Confirm' and the POST SETS the password. Hard guard: never POST when GET / shows errType 6 (FP @10015).
/Vlan8021QPvidRpm.htm (pvid_ds) was UNKNOWN; it is now INFERRED from QWE's real TL-SE2106 capture.
VLAN write: two incompatible shapes exist (SD bulk POST /Vlan8021QRpm.htm vs QWE per-VLAN GET qvlanSet.cgi). Both are kept and marked INFERRED. Not exposed in v1.
